Name: Seasonal Bespectacled Sebastian (edit of Ktruong's Sebastian)
Author: marchnshirley
Description:
PNGS only. To replace portraits in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url]﻿ by Poltergeister. Just paste in Assets - Portraits - Sebastian folder. 


Light beard is from a 2017 mod by ktruong. It's not being updated anymore so I updated it myself. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/877][b]Sebastian - New Hair and Moto Jacket[/b] [/url] 
Someone else also made a 1.6 update of the mod. Download this if you want a vanilla nonseasonal version with no glasses. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22245][b]Ktruong's Moto Sebastian - UPDATED[/b] [/url]
Glasses are edits of ConcernedApe's Harvey glasses. Seasonal portraits are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url]﻿ by IronZelly, Ailin, and Poltergeister.

I made these portraits because I wanted a different, older version of Sebastian to live the farmhouse after I married him: a little rugged, a little tired and more mature. This is what I envision how Sebastian would look while juggling ranching, chores, parenting and some adventuring with his spouse in the mines.
